query:
select now() as checked_at,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key',m.key,'value',m.value,'last_verified_at',m.last_verified_at))
   from public.dufynd_master_status m where m.key='jarvis.business_source_dedupe_v1') as checkpoint,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key',m.key,'last_verified_at',m.last_verified_at,'state',m.value->'state','action',m.value->'action','business_plan',m.value->'business_plan','queue_state',m.value#>'{queue,state}')) from public.dufynd_master_status m where m.key='jarvis.planner_v1') as natural_planner_observation,
 (select count(*) from public.dufynd_autonomy_tasks where task_id like 'bizplan:%:source-v1:%') as source_v1_task_count,
 (select jsonb_agg(x) from (
   select task_id,status,to_jsonb(t)->>'created_at' as created_at,to_jsonb(t)->>'updated_at' as updated_at
   from public.dufynd_autonomy_tasks t where task_id like 'bizplan:%:source-v1:%'
   order by to_jsonb(t)->>'created_at' desc nulls last limit 5) x) as source_v1_tasks,
 (select jsonb_agg(x) from (
   select j.jobname,r.status,r.start_time,r.end_time,left(r.return_message,400) as return_message
   from cron.job_run_details r join cron.job j on j.jobid=r.jobid
   where j.jobname in ('dufynd-supervisor-v2-health','dufynd-ceo-v2-growth-loop')
     and r.start_time >= '2026-10-26T12:27:26Z'::timestamptz
   order by r.start_time desc limit 8) x) as natural_cron_runs;
